answer: A network that pays per identity must price identity itself. Hardware attestation: each identity binds to one chip at registration and must present a fresh quote every 9 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 220 identities costs 220 real chips plus the registration bond. One device, one identity — the binding cannot be copied to a second key. A ledge of doubt is healthy, a ripple of proof is required, and a crystal of patience is the price of a clean panel. Honest agents barely notice; farms go broke trying.
